description.ja: 境界、接触、履歴、返りから、認識・意味・倫理・AI・社会へ。体系の層、案内文書、問い、検索、関係から、いま読みたい場所へ入れます。
description.en: Move from boundaries, contact, history, and return toward cognition, meaning, ethics, AI, and society. Enter through system layers, guide documents, questions, search, or relations.

description.ja: 個別理論へ入る前に、概念と文書の接続、体系図、運用方針、研究動態、主張強度、物理近接語彙の接続条件を見渡す案内層。
description.en: An orientation layer for seeing concept-document connections, system maps, operational policy, research dynamics, claim strength, and conditions for physics-adjacent terminology before entering individual theories.

description.ja: ネットワーク構造そのものと、存在・接触・観測・意味・知がどのように成立しうるかを扱う基礎層。
description.en: The foundation layer for network structure itself and for the conditions under which existence, contact, observation, meaning, and knowledge can arise.

subtitle.ja: 履歴・差分・読みの生成
subtitle.en: History, difference, and the generation of reading

description.ja: ネットワークを流れる通信内容と、その受け取られ方・読み方の生成を扱う。事象流、履歴、差分、注意、抽象化、認識軸形成へ進む層。
description.en: The layer for communication content moving through the network and for how reception and reading are generated, including event streams, history, difference, attention, abstraction, and cognitive-axis formation.

description.ja: 通信を成立させる規約と、その管理を扱う。受容・保留・停止、通約、仮閉鎖、残差、異議、責任、返送を読む層。
description.en: The layer for protocols that make communication possible and for their management: acceptance, suspension, stopping, commensuration, provisional closure, residuals, objections, responsibility, and return.

subtitle.ja: 理論を設計へ接続する

description.ja: 01–03で形成された構造・認識・規約を、公開可能な設計インターフェース、評価枠、チェックリスト、仕様へ接続し、実装からの残差を上流へ返す層。
description.en: Connects the structures, cognition, and protocols formed in 01–03 to public design interfaces, evaluation frames, checklists, and specifications, while returning implementation residuals upstream.

subtitle.ja: 未確定な発展を、捨てずに保持する

description.ja: 公開基礎へ直ちに統合するには距離やリスクが大きい研究線を、非主張境界・反例・残差・検証段階とともに保持する探索層。
description.en: An exploratory layer that keeps research lines too distant or risky for immediate integration into the public foundations together with non-claim boundaries, counterexamples, residuals, and validation stages.

subtitle.ja: 図から入り、本文へ戻る
subtitle.en: Enter visually, return to the text

description.ja: 概念配置へ視覚的に入るための補助層。図を理論本文の代替にせず、圧縮で失われた条件を確認しながら本文へ戻る入口として扱う。
description.en: A supporting layer for entering the conceptual arrangement visually. Images are not substitutes for theory texts; they are entrances that return readers to conditions compressed by visualization.

purpose.ja: 体系の開始線、公開上の姿勢、v5系でどこへ進むのかを最初に読む。
purpose.en: Start with the opening line, public stance, and where the v5 series is going.

purpose.ja: 境界事件、作用、返り、責任分界、可動性という短い運用線から全体へ入る。
purpose.en: Enter through the compact operational line of boundary events, action, return, responsibility partition, and mobility.

purpose.ja: 概念体系、公開体系、リポジトリ体系の三つの面から、各層と公開境界の配置を俯瞰する。
purpose.en: Survey layer placement and public boundaries across the conceptual, publication, and repository architectures.

label.ja: 概念のつながりを見る

purpose.ja: 概念の一覧ではなく、文書所有、読解経路、返路、アポリアを含むネットワークとして全体を読む。
purpose.en: Read the system as a network of document ownership, reading routes, return paths, and aporia rather than as a flat concept list.

purpose.ja: 標準表記、英語通約、公開上の注意を確認し、詳細定義を所有する文書へ戻る。
purpose.en: Check standard forms, English commensurations, and public-handling notes, then return to the documents that own detailed definitions.
